summary.headline: Judgments on Parents’ Fortune
summary.text: Astrological judgment of the father’s and mother’s wealth, dignity, success, and decline from the Sun, Moon, Saturn, house lords, triplicity lords, planetary leadership, angles, malefics, detriment, and the ascendant.
